system: PhilGEPS, Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System
what_it_holds_or_does: By law the single electronic portal for procurement, from planning to payment. The rules list its features: bulletin board, electronic catalogue, virtual store, electronic marketplace, electronic bidding, electronic small value procurement, electronic reverse auction, electronic payment, registry of suppliers, open data. They require every procuring entity to use it fully, and they require an audit trail that COA may verify at any time. The Procurement Service names two facilities of the modernized version for common-use supplies and equipment: a Virtual Store, and an eMarketplace whose first items are motor vehicles, airline tickets, software licences and cloud computing services. The state in September 2025, from a resolution of the GPPB: an earlier version, PhilGEPS 1.5, and the modernized version existed at the same time. As of 31 August 2025, 69 agencies used at least four modules of the electronic bidding facility of the modernized version. The earlier version takes no new posting from 1 March 2026, and its complete decommissioning was planned for the first semester of 2026. Payment in the Electronic Marketplace: an eWallet that PhilGEPS issues, a Government Purchase Card, or another authorized electronic mode. Since October 2025 the registry of the beneficial owners of bidders is published through PhilGEPS, on an interim authority of the GPPB. Whether the dates were kept, and which features are in use in October 2026: not verified
